contract: SDK and API DX overhaul spec, section 1.1 (wire schema locks)
note: The locked JSON body shape for every data-plane POST an SDK makes. Field names are frozen vocabulary (report 05, section 9): the ingestion worker validates these exact names, and the dashboard reads the columns they land in. A port that renames a field silently drops the data.

envelopes.description: Exposure batch. What every server SDK posts when a flag decision is served, and what the snippet posts for experiment exposures.

notes.eventId: UUID v4 stamped once at enqueue time so a retried batch carries the same ids and ingestion can deduplicate. The server mints one when an old client omits it; every SDK written from this contract sends it.
notes.experimentId: The rule id for a flag exposure, the experiment id for a web-experiment exposure.
notes.revenue: null on an exposure. Only conversion and order events carry money.
notes.timestamp: Milliseconds since the Unix epoch, as a number.
notes.pageUrl: Required by the ingestion schema, but an empty string is valid and is what server SDKs send: there is no page on a server.
notes.attributes: Registered attributes only. Unregistered keys are dropped server-side, so registering an attribute in the dashboard is what makes it queryable.

envelopes.description: Same envelope and same item shape as an exposure batch. Only eventName and the properties block differ, so holdout analysis can separate held-out traffic.

notes.experimentId: The holdout id, not the flag id.
notes.properties: Carries flagKey, flagId, holdoutId, and holdoutKey.

envelopes.description: Conversion and metric events. No experiment or variation: attribution happens server-side from the visitor's exposures.

notes.eventName: The metric key as configured in the dashboard. An unknown key is accepted and stored, so a typo shows up as an empty metric rather than an error.
notes.revenue: Decimal major units, or null for a non-revenue conversion.
notes.value: Numeric metric value for average-value metrics. null when the metric is a count.
notes.properties: NOT part of this body. Unlike the exposure batch, the metric batch has no properties field: anything sent under that name is stripped before storage, so it would look delivered and be gone. Put the number in `value` instead.

envelopes.description: Purchases. Sent immediately rather than batched on a timer, because an order is the event a customer least wants buffered.

notes.total: Decimal major units as displayed, not minor units. Must be a finite number greater than zero: a zero or negative total is rejected.
notes.test: true stores the order but excludes it from every revenue, profit, recommendation, and audience calculation.
notes.items: Each item takes sku, and optionally productKey, name, price, quantity, and category.
notes.pageUrl: Accepted and ignored by the orders route, unlike the exposure and metric batches. Server SDKs may send an empty string.

envelopes.description: SDK liveness. Sent after a successful datafile fetch. Drives the Connected, Stale, and Not connected states on the Environments page, so an SDK that never sends one looks offline no matter how well it works.

notes.sdkType: The package identifier, exactly as published: @avsbhq/node, @avsbhq/browser, avsb-python, avsb-go, avsb-ruby, avsbhq/avsb, cloud.avsb:avsb-sdk, Avsb.SDK.
notes.sdkVersion: The package version, read from build metadata rather than a hand-maintained literal.
